content: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
author: Seneca
story: Having survived political exile in Corsica, assassination plots under Caligula, and the volatile court of Emperor Nero, Seneca understood the wild swings of Roman fortune. He observed that many citizens waited helplessly for favorable circumstances, while the disciplined Stoic prepared his mind and skills in obscurity. When the unpredictable wave of opportunity finally breaks, only the prepared swimmer catches the ride.
reflectionPrompt: What capability, skill, or discipline can you sharpen in quiet preparation today so you are ready when your breakthrough opportunity arrives?
